title: third deferral escalates
why: A job deferred over and over is a job nobody owns. The third pass must stop chasing and put it in front of a person, which is precisely the behaviour a chase-forever loop hides.

job.procedure: Front brake service — Honda CB500X v3

step.title: Fit the new pads and torque the caliper bolts
step.explanation: An under-torqued caliper bolt backs out under braking heat and the caliper moves.
